correctness.rationale: Established directly from greedy subsequence matching in infinite 0101... that minimal host-prefix length c(u)=|u|+1_{u1=1}+number of equal adjacent letter pairs; this is exact for all binary u and starting-letter boundaries. Every even palindrome is uniquely b1...bh bh...b1, giving exact minimal-cost series t²z³(1+z)/(1-t²(z²+z⁴)); every odd palindrome of length >=3 adds center factor t(1+z²); the two length-one words give tz(1+z). Summing minimal costs and multiplying by (1-z)^-1 yields the stated bivariate generating function. Setting t=1 gives z(1+z)(1+z²)/((1-z)(1-z²-z⁴)); parity splitting and Fibonacci series give P_2m=2F_(m+3)-4, P_(2m+1)=F_(m+5)-4, with P0=0, and growth base sqrt(golden ratio). Independently enumerated every distinct subsequence string for all alternating prefixes N=0..22 and counted literal palindromes; obtained 0,1,2,4,6,9,12,17,22,30,38,51,64,85,106,140,174,229,284,373,462,606,750, agreeing with all Fibonacci cases. Enumeration is finite support, not proof beyond N22.
